resources.string: Availability check only; no session measurement yet
These export buttons contain the main sampling stream. Battery measurements are exported from Battery; self-monitoring from Self-monitoring.

Each value belongs to its own measurement stream and keeps its actual measurement time. Battery level, temperature and charging use the Battery settings and sampling interval. Thermal headroom is read no more often than every 10 seconds. Between scheduled readings the last value remains visible; it is not recorded again as a new measurement. A value is stale after two expected intervals or if the clock moves behind its timestamp. Self-monitoring aggregates also account for their publication window. Source availability checks do not refresh measurement time. Paused or ended sessions retain explicitly marked historical values; a new session does not reuse the previous session. Errors and denied access remain visible. Missing values are not zero and do not prove a resource shortage.
